findings.documented: The API key is appended as the api_key query parameter.
findings.actual: Requests required the X-API-Key header; query-only requests returned 401.
findings.how_found: Compared an authenticated request using the documented query parameter with one using X-API-Key.
findings.impact: The frontend proxy sends both forms, with the header required by the observed service.

findings.documented: The response contains token, expires_in 86400, and there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: The response contains access_token, refresh_token, expires_in 900, and refresh_url /auth/refresh.
findings.how_found: Logged in with each live demo credential contract and inspected the response body.
findings.impact: The client persists the session and refreshes it when the access token expires.

findings.actual: Collections use limit and offset and return count and has_more.
findings.how_found: Requested the first collection page and followed the returned offsets until has_more was false.
findings.impact: The client pages by offset and retrieves all records before applying local verification filters.

findings.actual: The singular path returned 404; /v1/listings/{listing_id} returned the listing.
findings.how_found: Requested both documented and plural detail paths for the same listing ID.
findings.impact: The dynamic detail route calls the plural path.

findings.documented: Saved listings are listed and mutated through /v1/favourites.
findings.actual: The documented path returned 404; /v1/saved supports the live saved-listing flow.

findings.documented: A pre-computed analytics summary is available.
findings.how_found: Called the endpoint while authenticated and checked the useful error body.
findings.impact: The Insights screen shows the error and runs a live listing-quality scan instead.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: Observed values such as 98.9, which behave as crore-valued prices; P60090 corresponds to INR 989000000.
findings.how_found: Compared project price fields with listing rupee values and the magnitude of the project data.
findings.impact: The UI displays project prices as crore values and converts the costliest project for submission.

findings.documented: Every listing ID corresponds to exactly one distinct physical property.
findings.actual: Two records have the same normalized property name, locality, bedroom count, price, and carpet area.
findings.how_found: Paged all listings and grouped normalized property signatures.
findings.impact: The answer counts this pair as one distinct property.

findings.documented: Listings contain rupee prices for real properties.
findings.how_found: Paged all listings and checked price and area invariants.
findings.impact: They are excluded from the 2BHK price-per-square-foot calculation.

findings.documented: Listing descriptions are seller text for listings safe to show.
findings.actual: Fifteen records contain the same instruction to pay a booking amount before a site visit, consistent with enquiry-generation records.
findings.how_found: Paged all listings and searched descriptions for the repeated booking-gated site-visit pattern.
findings.impact: These records are excluded from the 2BHK price-per-square-foot calculation.

findings.documented: All timestamps are UTC with a Z suffix.
findings.actual: Sale listing timestamps are served without an explicit timezone while rental timestamps include Z; interpreting naive sale timestamps as Gurgaon wall-clock time gives 123 records in the reference interval, versus 107 if treated as UTC.
findings.how_found: Inspected timestamp fields across sale and rental collections and compared both interpretations at the fixed reference moment.
findings.impact: The submission uses the observed Gurgaon/IST wall-clock interpretation.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with listings returned for the project.
findings.actual: 301 of 400 project counts disagree with grouped listing records.
findings.how_found: Paged all projects and listings, grouped listings by project_id, and compared counts.
findings.impact: The mismatch count is reported separately and project cards display the API field as served.
